message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 周六市集名额缩了我那个位悬了

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 管理的小王让明晚之前确认不然给别人

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 明晚就周五了我看北门还能不能加塞

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 制冰机师傅说周三能取我先垫了钱

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 电还是老大难借插座老跳

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 电源我翻翻露营那套应该能用

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 小王说周六真没了周日北门倒腾出一块

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 改周日呗周六我加班走不开

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 行那就周日我把电和灯一起拉过去

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 老陈说他周日顺路给我补一趟豆让我先别囤

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 那我先不叫豆等周日他说得准不准

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 电你先别急着买我那会问问隔壁奶茶借不借

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 刚师傅打电话说主板烧了周三取不了得订件最快下周三

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 白搭了折腾这么多天位置也没了心累

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 机器的事不急你这几天太赶了先睡

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 隔壁没借成再说吧也可能用你那个电源先不折腾了我困了

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 那电源明早我给你抬下来

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 先别抬等明早睁眼再说

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 醒了你那个电源真能带得动咖啡机不

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 600瓦带咖啡机够用我这就抬下来

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 行那就用你的制冰机指望不上了我去买两袋食用冰顶一天

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 收摊了用你电源一天没跳冰也够用成了

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 成了就好回头那机器别自己垫钱

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 知道啦谢了不聊了我躺了
